broadcasting.title: Broadcasting
broadcasting.summary: Send messages to all connected clients

methods.name: this.broadcastOthers(message)
methods.description: Sends to all EXCEPT the caller

tips: Use broadcastOthers() for chat messages to avoid echo
Broadcast is synchronous - doesn't wait for delivery

pubsub-channels.title: Pub/Sub Channels
pubsub-channels.summary: Subscribe to specific channels for targeted messaging
tips: Channels are created automatically on first subscribe
Call the returned function to unsubscribe
Last message is cached for late subscribers

controller-context.title: Controller Context (this)
controller-context.summary: Properties and methods available in controller functions

methods.name: this.clientId
methods.description: Unique identifier for the calling client

tips: Context is bound automatically - don't use arrow functions
this.agent has browser, os, device, and isBot properties

lifecycle-hooks.title: Lifecycle Hooks
lifecycle-hooks.summary: Run code at connection lifecycle events
tips: onConnect can close() the socket to reject connections
Attach custom data to socket for later use
onReceive/onSend can modify data or return false to block

auth-tiers.title: Authentication Tiers
auth-tiers.summary: Four-tier security model for progressive authentication
tips: OPAQUE means server never sees the raw password
Tier can only go up, never down (state machine)
Use requiresTier(n) for cleaner checks

file-transfers.title: Binary File Transfers
file-transfers.summary: Upload and download files over WebSocket
tips: Files are streamed in chunks for efficiency
Set timeouts in fileTransferOptions
Use <!B> tag prefix for binary keys

connection-states.title: Connection States
tips: Calls are buffered while connecting
Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff
Use walled state to detect captive portals

auto-routing.title: Auto-Routing
auto-routing.summary: File paths automatically become API endpoints
tips: Hot-reload updates routes automatically in dev
Duplicate endpoint names throw errors
Use controllersPath config to change 'api' directory
